basics.name: Dr.-Ing. Shreyas Giridharan
basics.label: Interdisciplinary Engineer | Patent Attorney Trainee
basics.summary: Interdisciplinary engineer transitioning into patent law, with a background spanning software development, geotechnics and mechanics. Currently training as a patent attorney candidate in Stuttgart, Germany, following a decade of research and teaching in computational geomechanics at the University of Stuttgart.

work.summary: Stuttgart, Germany. Focus areas: mechanical engineering, software (computer-implemented inventions, CII), physics.
highlights: Drafting patent applications and responses to office actions.
Conducting patent searches and prior-art analyses.

work.summary: Germany. Skills: technical writing, research, project leadership.
highlights: Project lead for numerical simulation of large deformations.
Principal lecturer for Numerical Geomechanics (German and English); consistently top-rated by students.
Supervised 5+ Master's theses and mentored 10+ research assistants.
Reviewer for academic journals on numerical methods in geotechnics.
Developed high-performance software for large-deformation simulations; delivered a 95% accurate monopile prediction model validated against field data from RWE AG.
Automated simulation workflows using Python, reducing pre/post-processing time by up to 80%.
Prepared technical project reports in German and English.
Contributed to 3 projects with 2 universities and 5 industry partners (RWE, innogy, GuD Consult, itap, BioConsult).
Developed open-source Python/MATLAB tools for teaching advanced constitutive modelling.
Managed software in the soil mechanics laboratory.
Ran finite element simulations in commercial tools to establish benchmark results for model validation.
Delivered tutorials for 3 Master's-level courses.
Implemented a novel multi-body contact algorithm in an internal codebase.
Wrote subroutines for coupled physical behaviour (e.g., fluid-structure interaction).
Created technical documentation for in-house simulation software.

Conducted feasibility studies and cost analyses for prototypes.
Main point of contact for international clients and prototype deliveries.
